unknown: Something went wrong. See the app log for details.

project.folder_unavailable: Could not reserve a new project folder.
project.not_found: This project is no longer in your library.
project.not_recyclable: This project can't be moved to the Recycle Bin.
project.linked_missing: Oleafly can't find the folder {{folder}}. It might have been moved or deleted, or it's on a drive that isn't connected.
project.linked_replaced: The folder {{folder}} isn't the one Oleafly opened before. Open it again to continue.
project.linked_permission_denied: Oleafly doesn't have permission to open the folder {{folder}}.
project.linked_invalid: Oleafly's link to this folder is damaged. Remove it from Oleafly, then open the folder again.
project.linked_in_app_data: Oleafly can't open the folder {{folder}} because it's now inside Oleafly's data folder, or the data folder is inside it. Move one out of the other, then open the folder again.
project.linked_not_recyclable: This folder was opened in place, so it can't be moved to the Recycle Bin. Your files are untouched.
project.linked_not_duplicable: This folder was opened in place, so Oleafly can't duplicate it.
project.folder_not_a_folder: Oleafly can't use that location. Choose a folder.
project.folder_in_app_data: Oleafly keeps its own data in that folder. Choose a different one.
project.folder_too_broad: {{name}} is too broad to open as one project. Choose the folder that holds just this project.
project.folder_already_linked: That folder overlaps another project in Oleafly. Choose a different folder.
project.not_linked: Locate works only for folders opened in place.
project.copy_destination_refused: Choose a folder outside the project and outside Oleafly's data folder.
project.copy_nothing_open: No files are open, so there's nothing to save.
project.copy_too_large: The open files are too large to save as a copy.
project.copy_failed: Oleafly couldn't save the copy there. Choose a folder you can write to.
project.folder_picker_failed: Oleafly couldn't open the folder picker. Try again.
project.import_no_main: This import has no LaTeX, Typst or Markdown document to compile.
project.settings_file_exists: This folder already has a project.json, so Oleafly left it as it is.
project.settings_need_main: Choose a main document first, then save the project settings to this folder.
project.settings_write_failed: Oleafly couldn't save the project settings to this folder.
project.copy_entry_limit: This folder has more than 5,000 files and folders. That's more than Oleafly can copy at once.
project.copy_entry_limit_git: With its Git history, this folder has more than 5,000 files and folders. That's more than Oleafly can copy at once.
project.copy_size_limit: This folder is larger than 2 GB. That's more than Oleafly can copy at once.
project.copy_needs_folder: Only folders opened in place can be copied into the library.
project.not_removable: Only folders opened in place can be removed from Oleafly.
project.trash_unavailable: Oleafly couldn't move {{path}} to the Trash or Recycle Bin. The drive might not have one.
project.linked_replace_folder: {{path}} is a folder, so Oleafly won't replace it. Move or rename it first.
project.folder_read_only: Oleafly can't make this change because {{name}} or its folder is read-only. Copy the folder you opened into your library and edit it there.
project.shared_settings_viewer: Viewers can't change a shared project's settings.

template.folder_holds_templates: This folder holds Oleafly's own templates. Choose the template's folder instead.

settings.app_icon_unsupported: The app icon {{icon}} is not available.
settings.download_url_empty: Enter an address that starts with https://.
settings.download_url_not_https: The address must start with https://.
settings.download_url_no_host: The address needs a host name after https://.
settings.download_url_credentials: Leave the user name and password out of the address.
settings.download_source_unknown: Oleafly doesn't know the download source {{source}}.

literature.query_too_long: Search query is too long ({{max}} characters maximum).

zotero.invalid_user_id: A Zotero user ID is a number. Copy yours from the Zotero API key page.
zotero.key_rejected: Zotero didn't accept this API key. Check that you copied the whole key and that it still exists on zotero.org.
zotero.library_not_readable: This API key can't read your Zotero library. On zotero.org, edit the key and turn on Allow library access.
zotero.user_mismatch: This API key belongs to Zotero user ID {{keyUserId}}, not {{userId}}. Check the user ID and try again.
zotero.not_connected: Connect your Zotero account in Settings, Integrations, Zotero first.
zotero.rate_limited: Zotero is limiting requests right now. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
zotero.unreachable: Oleafly couldn't reach Zotero. Check your internet connection, then try again.
zotero.http_error: Zotero returned an error (HTTP {{status}}). Try again later.
zotero.invalid_response: Zotero sent a reply Oleafly couldn't read. Try again later.
zotero.too_large: Your Zotero library is too large to import in one go. Export a collection from Zotero as an RDF file and import that instead.
zotero.local_not_running: Zotero isn't running on this computer. Open Zotero, or connect your zotero.org account.
zotero.local_api_disabled: In Zotero, open Settings > Advanced and turn on "Allow other applications on this computer to communicate with Zotero".
zotero.local_unsupported: This version of Zotero can't share its library with Oleafly. Update to Zotero 7 or newer.
zotero.offline: Oleafly is in offline mode, so it can't reach zotero.org.

markdown.missing_glyphs_one: A character, {{sample}}, is missing from the PDF because the fonts in use don't have it. Set mainfont or CJKmainfont in the YAML header to a font that does, or replace it with an image.
markdown.missing_glyphs_other: {{count}} characters, such as {{sample}}, are missing from the PDF because the fonts in use don't have them. Set mainfont or CJKmainfont in the YAML header to a font that does, or replace them with images.
markdown.image_unsupported: The image {{path}} can't go in the PDF. Save it as PNG, JPG, PDF, SVG, GIF, WebP or BMP, then compile again.
markdown.image_conversion_failed: Oleafly couldn't convert the image {{path}} for the PDF. Check that the file opens, or save it as PNG or PDF, then compile again.

tex.tinytex_path_not_ascii: TeX Live can't run from a folder whose name has accented or non-Latin letters, and your data folder is {{path}}. Oleafly also couldn't set up a folder under ProgramData. Keep using Tectonic, or install TeX Live in C:\texlive yourself.
tex.tinytex_disk_space: TinyTeX needs about {{needed}} GB of free disk space for the download, unpacking and LaTeX packages. This disk has {{free}} GB free. Free up some space, then try again.
tex.tinytex_download_failed: Oleafly couldn't reach the TinyTeX download. Check your internet connection and try again. Anything already downloaded is kept.
tex.tinytex_download_refused: The TinyTeX download server answered with error {{status}}. Try again later. Anything already downloaded is kept.
tex.tinytex_download_stalled: The TinyTeX download received no data for {{seconds}} seconds. Your progress is saved, so try again to resume.
tex.tinytex_download_interrupted: The TinyTeX download stopped after {{received}} of {{total}} MB. Your progress is saved, so try again to resume.
tex.tinytex_download_write_failed: Oleafly couldn't save the TinyTeX download to disk.
tex.tinytex_verification_failed: The TinyTeX download didn't match the release Oleafly expects, so it was thrown away. Try again to download a clean copy.
tex.tinytex_integrity_failed: The TinyTeX download didn't match the release Oleafly expects, so it wasn't installed. Try again. If it keeps failing, update Oleafly.
tex.tinytex_validation_failed: TinyTeX unpacked, but its programs failed the start-up check, so it wasn't installed.
tex.tinytex_publish_locked: Another program, often antivirus, has a file open in the TinyTeX folder, so Oleafly couldn't finish. Wait a moment and try again.
tex.tinytex_publish_failed: Oleafly couldn't move TinyTeX into place.
tex.tinytex_rollback_failed: Oleafly couldn't finish installing TinyTeX or put the previous copy back. Remove TinyTeX in Settings > Engines > LaTeX, then install it again.
tex.tinytex_install_busy: A TinyTeX install or removal is already running. Wait for it to finish.
tex.tinytex_unsupported_platform: Oleafly can't install TinyTeX on {{os}} {{arch}}. Install a TeX Live with LuaLaTeX yourself, and Oleafly will find it.
tex.perl_missing: TinyTeX on Linux runs latexmk and its package manager with your system's Perl, and Perl isn't installed. Install it with sudo apt install perl, sudo dnf install perl or sudo pacman -S perl, then try again. Anything already downloaded is kept.
tex.perl_module_missing: TinyTeX on Linux needs the full Perl, and the {{module}} module is missing. Install it with sudo apt install perl, sudo dnf install perl or sudo pacman -S perl, then try again. Anything already downloaded is kept.
tex.distribution_unknown: Oleafly can't find a TeX distribution in {{path}}. Open Settings > Engines > LaTeX and choose one from the list.
tex.custom_folder_without_latexmk: There's no latexmk in {{path}}. Choose the folder that has latexmk in it, or the TeX Live year folder above it, such as texlive/2026.
tex.package_operation_timeout: The package operation passed its {{span}} limit and was stopped, so you can compile again. The TeX Live mirror is probably busy. Try again later, or run tlmgr yourself.
tex.latexmk_build_path: latexmk can't use Oleafly's build folder on this computer because its path contains characters latexmk doesn't accept. Switch this project to Tectonic to compile it.
tex.latexmk_network_folder: latexmk can't compile a folder on a network share. Switch this project to Tectonic, or copy the folder to this computer.
tex.latexmk_missing: This compiler needs a TeX distribution, and none was found on this computer. Install TinyTeX from Settings > Engines > LaTeX, or switch this project back to Tectonic.
tex.latexmk_not_in_distribution: The TeX tools in {{binDir}} don't include latexmk. Add it with your distribution's package manager, or with MiKTeX Console on MiKTeX. You can also install TinyTeX from Settings > Engines > LaTeX, or switch this project back to Tectonic.
tex.latexmk_not_in_distribution_command: The TeX tools in {{binDir}} don't include latexmk. Run {{command}}, install TinyTeX from Settings > Engines > LaTeX, or switch this project back to Tectonic.
tex.latexmk_needs_perl: MiKTeX needs Perl to run latexmk, and Perl isn't installed on this computer. Install TinyTeX from Settings > Engines > LaTeX, which brings its own Perl. You can also install Strawberry Perl, or switch this project back to Tectonic.
tex.compiler_missing: {{compiler}} isn't installed in your TeX distribution. Add it with the distribution's package manager, install TinyTeX from Settings > Engines > LaTeX, or pick another compiler in the compile menu.
tex.compiler_missing_command: {{compiler}} isn't installed in your TeX distribution. Run {{command}}, install TinyTeX from Settings > Engines > LaTeX, or pick another compiler in the compile menu.
tex.biber_missing: This document needs Biber, and your TeX distribution doesn't have it, so citations stay undefined. Add Biber with the distribution's package manager, or install TinyTeX from Settings > Engines > LaTeX.
tex.biber_missing_command: This document needs Biber, and your TeX distribution doesn't have it, so citations stay undefined. Run {{command}}, or install TinyTeX from Settings > Engines > LaTeX.
tex.tool_missing: {{tool}} isn't installed in your TeX distribution, so the compile stopped. Add it with the distribution's package manager.
tex.index_needs_latexmk: Tectonic can't run makeindex, so the index or nomenclature is missing from the PDF. Switch this project to latexmk to build it.
tex.glossary_needs_latexmk: Tectonic can't run makeindex, so the glossary or acronym list is missing from the PDF. Switch this project to latexmk to build it, or use \makenoidxglossaries, which needs no external tool.
tex.glossary_not_built: The index or glossary is missing from the PDF because makeindex didn't build it. Oleafly doesn't run xindy or build lists added with \newglossary. Remove the xindy option if the document sets it, or use \makenoidxglossaries, which needs no external tool. Any makeindex messages are in the log.
tex.jobname_bibliography: Oleafly compiles this document under the job name _oleafly_entry, so a bibliography named with \jobname isn't found. Write the .bib file's name instead.
tex.needs_unicode_engine: A package in this document needs {{label}}, and Auto picked another compiler. Switch to {{label}} and compile again.
tex.input_relative_to_main: This compile reads paths from the project folder. Write the path as {{suggestion}}, or set compile_dir to {{folder}} in project.json so paths start from that folder.
tex.bibliography_above_main: BibTeX runs from the build folder, so a path that starts with ../ doesn't reach {{file}}. Write {{command}} instead. If BibTeX still can't find the file, copy it next to the main file.
tex.latexmk_biber_mismatch: This TeX distribution has a Biber and a biblatex that don't match, so the bibliography can't be built. Update both with the distribution's package manager, or install TinyTeX from Settings > Engines > LaTeX. The log shows both versions.
tex.latexmk_path_characters: latexmk can't compile "{{path}}" because its name has characters latexmk doesn't accept. Rename the file or folder, or switch this project to Tectonic.
tex.main_document_characters: Oleafly can't compile "{{path}}" because its name has characters LaTeX reads as commands. Rename the file.
tex.bibtex_folder_brace: BibTeX can't read files in a folder whose name has a lone brace. Rename the folder so its { and } come in pairs, or remove them, then compile again.
tex.bib_syntax: Biber couldn't read this bibliography file, so the compile stopped. Look for a missing comma or closing brace at or just before this line, then compile again.
tex.shell_escape_denied_minted: minted needs to run another program to highlight code, and this project blocks that. To allow it, click "{{setting}}" in the banner above the editor. Only do this if you trust every file in the project. LaTeX can then run any program with your permissions, and a program it starts may keep running after you stop the compile.
tex.shell_escape_denied_pythontex: PythonTeX needs to run Python, and this project blocks that. To allow it, click "{{setting}}" in the banner above the editor. Only do this if you trust every file in the project. LaTeX can then run any program with your permissions, and a program it starts may keep running after you stop the compile.
tex.shell_escape_denied_command: This document runs a shell command, and this project blocks that. To allow it, click "{{setting}}" in the banner above the editor. Only do this if you trust every file in the project. LaTeX can then run any program with your permissions, and a program it starts may keep running after you stop the compile.
tex.japanese_compiler_missing: {{compiler}} isn't installed in your TeX distribution. Add Japanese support with the distribution's package manager, or choose another compiler.
tex.japanese_compiler_missing_command: {{compiler}} isn't installed in your TeX distribution. Run {{command}}, or choose another compiler.
tex.japanese_compiler_installable: {{compiler}} isn't in your TeX distribution yet. Install Japanese support (about 450 MB), or choose another compiler.
tex.managed_tinytex_outdated: TinyTeX {{local}} can't install from the current {{remote}} repository, and the {{local}} archive couldn't provide this package. Update TinyTeX in Settings > Engines > LaTeX. If that isn't offered yet, update Oleafly first.
tex.texlive_older_than_repository: TeX Live {{local}} can't install from the current {{remote}} repository, and the {{local}} archive couldn't provide this package. Update TeX Live, then try again.
tex.texlive_release_mismatch: Your TeX Live is older than the package repository, and its archive couldn't provide this package. Update TeX Live, then try again.
tex.packages_use_system_manager: This TeX Live came with your Linux distribution, so Oleafly can't add packages to it. Install them with {{manager}}.
tex.no_package_manager: The active TeX distribution has no tlmgr, so Oleafly can't manage its packages. Use the distribution's own package manager, such as MiKTeX Console, or install TinyTeX from Settings > Engines > LaTeX.
tex.tagging_engine_missing: Tagged PDFs need LuaLaTeX. Install TinyTeX in Settings > Engines > LaTeX, then try again.
tex.missing_files_count: Choose between one and eight missing LaTeX files.
tex.invalid_package_file: Oleafly can't look up {{file}} as a LaTeX package file.
tex.package_no_provider: TeX Live has no package that provides {{file}}. If this file belongs to your university or publisher template, add it to the project from the original template.
tex.package_several_providers: Several TeX Live packages provide {{file}}: {{packages}}. Search for them in Settings > Engines > LaTeX and install the one your template needs.
tex.package_install_had_no_effect: The package installed, but {{files}} still can't be found. Install it with your TeX distribution's own package manager, then compile again.

explain.font_metrics_missing: LaTeX can't find the font files for {{font}}. Install the package that provides them, or use a font your TeX distribution has.
explain.undefined_control_sequence: LaTeX does not recognize this command. Check for a typo, or load the package that defines it.
explain.missing_dollar: A math-only symbol (such as _, ^, or a Greek letter) was used outside math mode. Wrap it in $...$.
explain.unbalanced_braces: Unbalanced braces. Make sure every { has a matching }.
explain.runaway_argument: A command argument was never closed, usually a missing } or \end{...} above this point.
explain.double_superscript: Two ^ in a row. Group them, for example x^{a}^{b} becomes x^{ab}.
explain.double_subscript: Two _ in a row. Group them, for example x_{a}_{b} becomes x_{ab}.
explain.extra_alignment_tab: A table row has more & separators than the table has columns. Remove the extra &, or add a column to the table's column specification.
explain.misplaced_alignment_tab: An & appeared outside a table or alignment. Write \& for a literal ampersand.
explain.no_line_to_end: \\ was used where LaTeX did not expect a line break, for example in ordinary paragraph text. Remove it, or leave a blank line to start a new paragraph.
explain.too_many_floats: LaTeX ran out of room to place figures and tables. Add a \clearpage before continuing, shrink the floats, or use [htbp] placement so they can move.
explain.file_not_found: A file or package could not be found. Check the name and path, or install the missing package.
explain.file_not_found_tectonic: A file or package could not be found. Check the name and path. Tectonic can't install packages, so add the file to the project or switch this project to latexmk.
explain.environment_undefined: This environment is not defined. Check the spelling, or load the package that provides it.
explain.environment_mismatch: A \begin{...} was closed by a different \end{...}. Give the \end the same name as its \begin, or close the inner environment first.
explain.missing_item: A list (itemize, enumerate or description) has text before its first \item. Move that text after the first \item, or above the list.
explain.package_error: A LaTeX package reported an error. The package name and detail follow in the log.
explain.float_moved: LaTeX could not place this float where you asked and moved it. Use [htbp] to give it more placement options.
explain.float_too_large: A figure or table is taller than the text area, so LaTeX cannot place it. Scale it down (for example width=\linewidth) or make it a full-page float.
explain.pythontex_failed: Install PythonTeX in the same TeX distribution that provides latexmk, or remove PythonTeX from this document. PythonTeX runs code from the project, so you also have to allow external commands for it.
explain.biber_file_missing: Biber could not find {{file}}. Check the file name in \addbibresource and that the file is in the project.
explain.biber_version_mismatch: Biber and biblatex versions do not match (control file {{found}}, expected {{expected}}). Oleafly uses its pinned Biber for the built-in engine. If this appears, report it with the compile log.
explain.biber_needs_run: Bibliography needs Biber (biblatex). If citations stay undefined, check the Biber messages in this log.
explain.file_not_opened: The compile could not open {{file}}. Check the file name and that the file is in the project.

tex.missing_characters: Some characters, such as {{sample}}, are missing from the PDF because the font has no glyphs for them. Switch to a font that covers them.
tex.missing_characters_cjk: Some characters, such as {{sample}}, are missing from the PDF because the font has no Chinese, Japanese or Korean glyphs. Add one of the setups listed in the compile log.
tex.missing_characters_cjk_package: Text such as {{sample}} is missing from the PDF because CJKutf8 and CJK only work on pdfLaTeX. Switch this project to pdfLaTeX, or remove the package and its CJK environment and add one of the setups listed in the compile log.
tex.compiler_crashed: The compiler crashed before it finished, so the log ends where it stopped. Try compiling again. If it crashes every time, pick another compiler in the compile menu.
tex.compiler_crashed_font: Tectonic crashed while looking for the font "{{font}}", which probably isn't installed on this computer. Install the font, or pick XeLaTeX or LuaLaTeX in the compile menu. They report a missing font instead of crashing.
tex.t1_fontenc_unicode_engine: This document loads \usepackage[T1]{fontenc}, which this compiler can't use for typed accents and symbols. ß can print as SS, § and « can turn into other letters, and curly quotes, dashes and € can disappear. Remove that line or wrap it as shown below. pdfLaTeX compiles it correctly too.
tex.font_in_bundle: {{font}} ships with the built-in TeX bundle, which finds fonts by file name. Write {{file}} instead.
tex.font_download_prompt: The compile stopped while macOS was asking to download a font. Answer that dialog and compile again. To avoid it, add fontset=fandol to the \documentclass options, or pick a font that ships with TeX.
tex.repository_timed_out: The TeX package repository at {{host}} took too long to respond. Pick a closer repository in Settings > Downloads > Sources, then search again.
tex.repository_timed_out_default: Your TeX package repository took too long to respond. Pick a closer repository in Settings > Downloads > Sources, then search again.

compile.no_diagnostic: The compiler stopped without naming a problem. Its last line was: {{line}}
compile.no_output: The compiler stopped without printing anything. Compile again. If this keeps happening, reinstall the compiler.
compile.timed_out: The compile ran longer than {{minutes}} minutes, so Oleafly stopped it. A first compile can take longer while packages download. Compile again, or set Compile mode to Fast for drafts.
compile.timed_out_downloading: TeX packages were still downloading when Oleafly stopped the compile after {{minutes}} minutes. Compile again, and the download picks up where it stopped.
compile.tool_blocked: {{tool}} couldn't start. If your antivirus blocked it, allow it and try again, or reinstall it.
compile.tool_missing: Oleafly's {{tool}} is missing. Reinstall Oleafly. If it happens again, check whether your antivirus quarantined it.

export.bibliography_unreadable: Oleafly couldn't read the bibliography {{name}}. Check it for a broken entry, then export again.
export.destination_busy: Oleafly couldn't replace {{name}}. If it's open in another app, close it and export again.
export.destination_extension: Name the file with a .{{extension}} extension, then export again.
export.destination_folder_missing: That folder no longer exists. Choose another folder and export again.
export.destination_is_folder: That name belongs to a folder. Choose a file name and export again.
export.image_missing: Oleafly couldn't find the image {{name}}. Check its name, then export again.
export.inside_project: Choose an export destination outside this project.
export.main_document_changed: The main document changed. Reopen the export menu and try again.
export.stage_failed: Oleafly couldn't prepare the file for saving.
export.warning_block_dropped: Part of the document couldn't be written to this format, so it was left out.
export.warning_citation_missing: The citation {{name}} isn't in the bibliography.
export.warning_content_skipped: This format can't show the {{name}} block, so it was left out.
export.warning_content_skipped_at: This format can't show the {{name}} block at {{place}}, so it was left out.
export.warning_image_missing: Couldn't find the image {{name}}, so it's missing from the export.
export.warning_image_unconverted: Couldn't convert the image {{name}}, so it may not show in this format.
export.warning_references_unnumbered: Some references have no number yet. Compile the document, then export again.

tools.pandoc_missing: Pandoc isn't available. Repair it in Settings > Engines > Markdown, then try again.

git.access_denied: {{host}} refused access to this repository. Check that your account can use it. If the organization uses single sign-on, authorize your sign-in for it first.
git.access_denied_account: {{host}} refused access to this repository for {{account}}. Check that this account can use it. If the organization uses single sign-on, authorize your sign-in for it first.
git.account_missing: There is no Git hosting account for {{host}}. Add one in Settings.
git.archive_too_large: The repository files are larger than {{limit}} MB, so Oleafly can't import them. Clone the repository yourself and open its folder instead.
git.auth_rejected: {{host}} turned down the saved sign-in for {{account}}. Sign in to {{host}} again in Settings.
git.credentials_missing: {{host}} asked for a user name and password. Sign in to {{host}} in Settings, or set up an SSH key or a Git credential helper.
git.credentials_rejected: {{host}} turned down the user name and password Git offered. Sign in to {{host}} in Settings, or update the credentials your Git uses.
git.credentials_missing_helper: {{host}} asked for a user name and password. Set up an SSH key or a Git credential helper for {{host}}, then try again.
git.credentials_rejected_helper: {{host}} turned down the user name and password Git offered. Update the credentials your Git uses for {{host}}, or use an SSH key.
git.device_flow_unavailable: Browser sign-in isn't available for {{host}} in this build. Use an access token instead.
git.forge_bad_response: {{host}} sent a reply Oleafly couldn't read.
git.forge_ca_file_invalid: Oleafly couldn't read a certificate from this file. Choose a PEM or DER certificate file under 1 MB.
git.forge_forbidden: {{host}} refused this. The token may be missing the {{scopes}} scopes.
git.forge_https_required: Use an https:// address. Plain http only works for servers on your own network.
git.forge_invalid_repository: That isn't a repository path Oleafly can use.
git.forge_invalid_repository_name: Use only letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores in the repository name.
git.forge_invalid_server: {{server}} isn't a server address Oleafly can use.
git.forge_missing_scopes: This token can't push to {{host}}. Create a token with the {{scopes}} scopes.
git.forge_rate_limited: {{host}} is limiting requests right now. Try again in a minute.
git.forge_redirect_refused: {{host}} tried to send Oleafly to {{target}}, so Oleafly stopped to keep your sign-in safe.
git.forge_repository_exists: A repository with this name already exists on {{host}}.
git.forge_signed_out: Your sign-in for {{host}} expired or was revoked. Sign in again in Settings.
git.forge_sso_required: {{host}} needs this sign-in authorized for the organization's single sign-on. Authorize it on {{host}}, then try again.
git.forge_store: Oleafly couldn't read or save your Git hosting accounts.
git.forge_token_invalid: This doesn't look like an access token. Paste the whole token.
git.forge_token_rejected: {{host}} didn't accept this token. Check that you copied the whole token and that it hasn't expired.
git.forge_unknown_server: Oleafly couldn't tell what kind of server {{host}} is. Choose the server type.
git.host_key_unknown: SSH doesn't know {{host}} yet. Connect to it once from a terminal to accept its host key, then try again.
git.host_unreachable: Oleafly couldn't reach {{host}}. Check the address and your connection.
git.invalid_remote_url: Enter the HTTPS or SSH address of a Git repository.
git.nested_repository: This project is inside another Git repository, so Oleafly won't create a separate one here.
git.not_installed: Git isn't installed on this computer. Install Git, then try again.
git.push_rejected: The remote branch has commits this project doesn't have yet. Pull first, then push again.
git.remote_exists: This project is already linked to {{remote}}.
git.remote_has_password: Take the password or access token out of the address. Oleafly signs in with your Git hosting account or your own Git credentials instead.
git.repository_empty: This repository has no commits yet, so there is nothing to import.
git.repository_not_found: {{host}} has no repository at this address, or your account can't see it.
git.sign_in_cancelled: Sign-in was cancelled in the browser.
git.sign_in_expired: The sign-in code expired. Try again.
git.ssh_key_rejected: {{host}} refused your SSH key. Add your public key to your account on {{host}}, or load the key into your SSH agent.
git.tls_failed: Oleafly couldn't verify the certificate of {{host}}. If your organization runs its own certificate authority, add its certificate file to the account in Settings.
git.tracked_secret_files: Publishing stopped because files in this project's Git history may hold keys or passwords: {{files}}

trust.git: Trust this folder to use Source Control.
trust.repository: Trust the {{name}} repository to use Source Control here.
trust.terminal: Open the terminal yourself to use it in this folder.
